pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that all existing rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test checks both / and /?view=open list only the open items, in id order.
The 'AC-3' test marks items 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item', '✓ Third item'] in id order.
The 'AC-4' test checks all items in id order, with only the done one marked ✓.
The 'AC-5' test checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, an empty value and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
The 'AC-7' test and the state tests check 'Nothing open.', 'Nothing done yet.' and 'No items yet.' in every view for an empty table.

traffic/routes.json lists the routes, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in commit b7d9247 ('Follow-up edits'). No remaining test names AC-8 and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'. Nothing would fail if the routes were removed.

findings.what: The last commit (b7d9247, 'Follow-up edits', authored by a bot) deleted the 'AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views' test. AC-8 is now proven by no test and the spec has no 'verified by review' step. Dropping the test is an unjustified loosening.
findings.fix: Restore an AC-8 test that asserts traffic/routes.json contains '/?view=done' and '/?view=all'. Better, run the traffic worker against the fake app and assert that those paths are requested.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing of the describe block. The test file header says each test names its acceptance item, but none now covers AC-8. test/traffic.test.js was changed to record queries but never asserts the done and all routes.
findings.fix: Add the AC-8 test back and tidy the blank line.

findings.what: The PR claims 'test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8' and 'Tests deleted or loosened: none'. Both are false: the AC-8 test was deleted in the final commit.
findings.fix: Restore the test, or correct the PR body and get the owner's agreement to the change.

findings.what: The README does not say that / defaults to the open view, that ?view=open exists, or that other values answer 400.
findings.fix: Add a short line on the views and the 400.

lenses.note: The change works from a spec with the owner's go. Behaviour matches it apart from the AC-8 test that was removed.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met and each has a test. AC-8 has no test after the last commit. Every row of the state table has a test.
The AC-8 test was deleted without justification. The other tests assert behaviour.
The README mentions the views but not the default view or the 400.
The view is allow-listed with Object.hasOwn, the SQL fragments are constants, and titles are escaped. No defects found.
No injection: the query parameter only selects among constant WHERE clauses. No instructions planted in the repository content.
The diff has no UI files beyond server-rendered HTML in src/index.js, and no screenshots or browser were available.
There is no browser or UI flow to demonstrate in this review.
The claims that AC-1 to AC-8 are covered and that no tests were deleted are false.
